summary: Verified the public no-login Harswaggitify flow on the live URL, production build, backend compile, and core backend status routes.
action_items: Add backend regression tests under /app/backend/tests; the pytest run currently has no collected tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Curated recommendations are local static data and Spotify itself is link-only, as intentionally specified. Legacy Spotify OAuth endpoints remain in the backend but are not user-visible or called by the frontend.

success_rate.backend: 100% (manual health/status checks; no pytest tests collected)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL tested at desktop and mobile sizes. No-login load, mood selection, free-text input, surprise-me, playlist preview, six Spotify search links, and absence of developer/OAuth copy all passed. Backend /api/, /api/spotify/status, and unconfigured /api/spotify/login were checked.
rca of the issue: No product defects reproduced. Pytest exited with code 5 because /app/backend/tests contains no test files; this is a coverage gap rather than an API failure.
